scientific_integrity: The uniform proof uses cyclotomic factorization, an exact layer generating function, Thompson's prime-extension criterion, and explicit carry replacements. The included finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the complete even phi-practical family with at most one odd prime factor. It does not determine full degree multiplicities for three-or-more-prime support, and an obscure equivalent historical formulation cannot be ruled out by search alone.
title: Interior divisor degrees are never unique for two-prime φ-practical numbers
